ui.tz_milestone_guide: Rohe waenga & hurihanga (UTC{tz_str}): Ka whakatika te rīreti i te rohe waenga whakaatu; mā te huri i te UTC e neke ai pea tētahi kaihoko ki te rā o mua, ki te rā rānei kei te tū mai.
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Mīhini Wā: Nekehia ngā rā ki muri, ki mua rānei i runga i te rīreti ki te tirotiro i ngā raraunga/matapae o mua, o anamata rānei, ki te whakatairite i ngā hītori, me te whakatairite āhuatanga. Tiro-anake; kāore e pāhia ngā raraunga take.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 taketake VN: he pai ki ngā raraunga tūturu, ka tirotiro i te rere o te wāhanga & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + te wiri puta noa i a k, p; i ngā āputa 16 / 116 / 132, i te huringa rānei 1072 ka whakamahi i te k*116 + p*16 puta noa i a k, p kia ōrite ai te wāhanga, me te whakakī whakamua i ngā āputa ki te mea kei te ngaro.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Ka tautuhi ki te manawataki 119 (k*119 + te wiri); ina ko te āputa he 16 / 116 / 132 ka pā rānei ki te huringa 1072 (tauira 14-hipanga), ka whakamahi i te k*116 + p*16 puta noa i a k, p hei neke ki te Wāhanga A e ōrite ana (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: Ka takai i te manawataki 119 (k*119 + te wiri); i ngā āputa 16 / 116 / 132, i te huringa rānei 1072 (k*116 + p*16 puta noa i a k, p), he pai ki te wāhanga kua whakatikaina A2 / C7, ā, ka hoki anō ki tētahi atu ina ngaro ngā raraunga.
